name: Spirit Mastery (Mythic)
body:
Your ability in dancing with the spirits is unparalleled.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd mythic tier, medium spirit class ability.

Benefit(s): You gain the spirit swap mythic ability from the path of the mystic, whatever your mythic path is.
